data.name: Azhari
data.gender_notes: Azhari is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'azhar', meaning 'wise, knowledgeable, intelligent'. In the Quran, Allah (swt) refers to those who are guided and possess knowledge as 'azhara' (35:28). The name Azhari carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azhari usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who embodies the knowledge and wisdom of Allah
data.etymology: Azhari belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azhari total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Azhari signifies intelligence, wisdom, and knowledge. In various Islamic societies and communities, the name is often associated with scholars, intellectuals, and thinkers. It carries a sense of uniqueness and pride, as the person carrying this name is considered to be a bearer of valuable knowledge and understanding within their community and beyond.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Azhari holds deeper significance in the context of Islamic teachings. In the Quran, Allah (swt) refers to those who are guided and possess knowledge as 'azhara'. By bestowing this name upon someone, the parents or guardians are expressing the hope that the child shall grow up to be a wise and knowledgeable individual in search of truth and knowledge. The name encourages the pursuit of knowledge, which is an essential pillar of the Islamic faith and a primary means for individuals to draw closer to Allah. Moreover, the name serves as a reminder of the virtue of intellect, which Allah highly values and advocates for in the Quran. In essence, the name Azhari inspires the individual to strive for knowledge and wisdom, both secular and spiritual, throughout their life, ultimately leading them towards greater closeness to Allah.
